content.text: Answer concisely with settings names and exact trigger math, no preamble. (1) What context window size does the model in this project run (Opus 4.6/4.7, Sonnet)? Is 1M active here? (2) Exactly when does auto-compact fire — is CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE a percentage of the full window, and what is the default in `claude config get`? (3) If my sessions realistically stay ~40% of window (observed standing context 350-450K on a 1M window), would setting PCT_OVERRIDE=75 ever trigger? What value WOULD trigger earlier than now? (4) List the exact env/settings keys for controlling context retention of images/tool-results.
